definitions.explanation: to read something over again, often to confirm understanding or for enjoyment

examples.japanese: {手紙|てがみ}を{何度|なんど}も{読|よ}み{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I reread the letter many times.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}は{読|よ}み{返|かえ}す{価値|かち}がある。
{契約書|けいやくしょ}の{内容|ないよう}をもう{一度|いちど}{読|よ}み{返|かえ}してから{署名|しょめい}してください。
examples.english: Please reread the contents of the contract once more before signing.

notes:
{読|よ}み{返|かえ}す is a compound verb combining {読|よ}む (to read) + {返|かえ}す (to return/repeat), meaning to read again.

VERB TYPE: Godan verb (u-verb), transitive

CONJUGATION:
- {読|よ}み{返|かえ}さない (negative)
- {読|よ}み{返|かえ}した (past)
- {読|よ}み{返|かえ}して (te-form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本|ほん}を{読|よ}み{返|かえ}す (to reread a book)
- {手紙|てがみ}を{読|よ}み{返|かえ}す (to reread a letter)
- {何度|なんど}も{読|よ}み{返|かえ}す (to reread many times)

RELATED 〜{返|かえ}す COMPOUND VERBS:
- {書|か}き{返|かえ}す (to write back)
- {聞|き}き{返|かえ}す (to ask again)
- {見|み}{返|かえ}す (to look back at)
- {繰|く}り{返|かえ}す (to repeat)
